proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.saveSourceFilter
proposed_widenings.justification: The robe needs saving-throw advantage that applies only when the save is caused by a spell or other magical effect. The existing surface can narrow by save ability, but not by the source/cause of the saving throw.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

notes: Authored as a composite passive magic item with three honest subsets: unarmored base AC 15 + Dex, +2 spell save DC, and +2 spell attack rolls while worn. The Magic Resistance rider was omitted pending a save-source filter on modify_roll_advantage. Typecheck and tracer both passed.
